text:
anya: quick UI review: spotted a few inconsistencies between console labels and in-product docs panels. dropping notes so we can triage.

sam: please be brief, will forward to eng.

anya: issues summary:
- label mismatch: form shows 'model alias' but our docs use 'pinned model'
- help panels vary in depth: some embed full guides, others only a summary + link
- toast CTAs land on top of docs with no anchor or tracking
- help drawer accessibility: ESC sometimes doesn't close and focus isn't restored

maria: +1 on the naming. suggestion: standardize on 'Pinned model' in UI, but show alias in parens for compatibility.

kevin: on anchors: propose pattern: /docs/{slug}#{section-id}?utm_source=console&utm_campaign=help_cta. keeps analytics useful.

docs-bot: opened RED-3502 for console->docs term mapping and CTA UTM standard. assigning to docs-squad.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist (short): role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" on help drawer, set focus to first interactive element on open, ESC invokes same handler as close button, restore visible focus outlines.

sam: engineering ask: can docs add stable ids for quantization, rollouts, caching so we can link directly?

docs-bot: yes. will add section ids to the long pages and include a mapping CSV.

maria: copy suggestions (short):
- inline summary CTA: "Read more" (opens modal)
- external doc CTA: "Open docs" (opens new tab, tracked)
- error toast CTA: "See troubleshooting steps" -> anchors to the error section

kevin: prioritization: P0 = help drawer ESC/a11y, P1 = canonicalize 'Pinned model' + SDK migration note, P2 = anchors + UTM, P3 = inline summary pattern.

anya: next steps: docs to produce mapping CSV, UX to mock inline-summary pattern, eng to add ESC e2e test. I'll schedule a quick follow-up if needed.

sam: noted, adding tasks to the sprint board.

docs-bot: RED-3502 updated with ETA and template.

a11y-bot: adding screen reader test matrix to the ticket.

maria: i'll draft the short copy variants and post in this thread later today.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
